spec_match.rationale: Runs the real hinted call, names AudioSelectionPreferenceEnum's sole 'preferred' value, and honestly reports the observable outcome rather than claiming the hint caused it.

interactive.rationale: The post-success deadlock is fixed: capture -> stop -> capture cycles were driven end-to-end against the real getDisplayMedia (headless Chromium with an auto-selected fake capture source) — Stop enables on success, Stop restores Capture, and a second capture succeeds.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The blurb promises the single hinted call with label, settings, and a live level meter, and the page implements exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Rejection, pagehide races, audio-absent shares, and now the browser's own 'stop sharing' UI (video track 'ended' listener restores controls and tears down the analyser) are all handled.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus 5085785343787008 and the audioSelection spec anchor are linked.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite passed 8/8 in this browser previously, including the track-inspection and cleanup surfaces this page depends on (suite untouched).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CDP with --auto-select-desktop-capture-source + fake media device: full cycle observed (Stop enabled after success, live preview visible, meter text reached 'audio level: 62%', stop restored controls, second capture worked, synthetic track 'ended' dispatch restored controls); console clean except the environmental fonts.googleapis.com failure; note the real user-facing picker UI itself cannot be exercised headlessly.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts record resolved (audio/video presence) and fallback outcomes separately.

design_system.rationale: Variables and button overrides are correct, but the emerald '.ok' probe text on stone (~3.7:1) still misses AA at its small size — a pattern shared with the sibling pages, left for a coordinated fix.

accessibility.rationale: The level meter is now role=meter with throttled aria-valuenow/aria-valuetext plus a visible mono text mirror ('audio level: N%' / 'no active capture' / 'no audio track in this capture'), deliberately not an aria-live firehose; meta stays a polite role=status and all controls are native buttons.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 1280x1600 and 360x740 DPR3 touch via CDP emulation: no horizontal overflow, controls and meter text render on both classes; harness-recorded ok/ok (2026-07-24) still stands.

openQuestions.title: Raise the emerald probe text to AA
openQuestions.detail: Shared with the sibling pages: .ok emerald on stone measures ~3.7:1 at 0.78rem, below the 4.5:1 bar. Fix the shared pattern across preferred-capture, hint-vs-default, and options-inspector in one coordinated pass so the pages stay consistent.

openQuestions.title: Confirm the repaired flow against the real picker on a headed browser
openQuestions.detail: This pass exercised the true getDisplayMedia success path only via --auto-select-desktop-capture-source (no human picker), and the browser-side stop was simulated with a synthetic 'ended' dispatch on the live track. A headed chrome-devtools-mcp session should click through the real picker and the real 'Stop sharing' bar once.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible continuously updating level meter role meter text equivalent
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Expose continuously-updating visual measures through a meter role with value semantics and a text equivalent, throttled so assistive tech is not flooded.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The level bar became role=meter with aria-valuemin/max/now + aria-valuetext updated at most every 250ms, mirrored by a visible 'audio level: N%' text line; deliberately no aria-live on the fast-changing value.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP run showed levelText 'audio level: 5%'/'62%' during capture and 'no active capture' after stop, with aria-valuenow tracking.

guidanceConsulted.query: aria-live region announcing updated results after select change
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep discrete state changes announced via an existing polite status region rather than adding competing live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Capture/stop/ended outcomes keep appending to the existing role=status meta region; the new meter text intentionally stays out of the live region.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Meta tail observed updating through capture/stop/ended transitions in the CDP run.

summary: Fixed in place with the smallest patch: the success branch now enables Stop (the one missing line that deadlocked both controls after any successful capture), a video-track 'ended' listener restores the controls when sharing is stopped from the browser's own UI, and the visual-only level meter gained a role=meter + throttled text equivalent. The full capture -> stop -> capture cycle plus the ended path were verified against the real getDisplayMedia in headless Chromium 141 using an auto-selected fake capture source (real picker UX and real stop-sharing bar remain for a headed pass); console clean except the environmental fonts failure. The shared emerald-on-stone probe-text AA miss is left as a coordinated sibling fix.
